data.text: What should I build while following a Golang backend roadmap?

Build one small API that you can explain and test. Start with request routing and JSON responses, add input validation and consistent errors, then persist records in a relational database. Add tests for successful requests, invalid input and missing records before introducing caches or splitting the application into services. The Go project’s REST API and database tutorials provide concrete exercises for these stages.
How do I know when I am ready for the next stage?

Use working milestones instead of a fixed deadline. You should be able to run the API locally, explain its data model, test important failures, cancel slow operations and diagnose a problem from logs or profiling. Add concurrency only where the work benefits from it; start with the simplest deployment that meets your needs. A production system also needs an application-specific security review and operational checks.
